messages.author: 4427b64dfcb5da5b
messages.subject: PC priors for Besagproper2 model
parts:
Hi,

I want to compute the joint PC prior for the Besagproper2 model. And I think the precision tau already has a closed form as a type-2 Gumbel distribution. Then, how to compute the density of the mixing parameter phi? Also, I am assuming that the joint prior can be multipled by these two prior densities?


Thanks,
B

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] PC priors for Besagproper2 model
parts:
Hi,

You mean \lambda in the inla.doc("besagproper2")? This \lambda is a kind of bad parametrization since that \lambda is a mixing in the precision. A better one is the 'bym2' model, see inla.doc("bym2"), where the mixing parameter is in the covariance, thus much easier to interpret [1].

[1] https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/abs/10.1177/0962280216660421?journalCode=smma

best regards,
Elias

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] PC priors for Besagproper2 model
parts:
Thanks! And does that mean if I want to use the besagproper2 (Leroux prior), the PC prior is not available? I see the inla.doc("besagproper2"), the default priors for both parameters are not PC priors (loggamma and normal). However, for "bym2", the default prior are all PC priors. Just want to make sure. Thanks!

Thanks,
B
